# Tomato Soup

![Recipe image](https://cdn.example.test/hero.jpg)

A simple soup.

## Ingredients
- 2 tomatoes
- 1 onion

## Instructions
1. Chop the tomatoes and the onion into small pieces.
2. Simmer everything together until soft and blend it.
3. Serve hot with fresh bread and a spoon of cream.

   ![Served soup](https://cdn.example.test/serve.jpg)
